html: I imagine him having some type of keratinous beak-like structure where a normal human's nose should be. As he is part emu, he has very long legs, which end in three-toed feet that allow him to run at speeds of 30 mph. And with the help of his avian lungs, he can maintain this speed for long distances. As for his hair; I don't really know. Have yet to figure it out. That's all I can think of right now. I'll update this page soon.
